parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside under `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/`. The two methods — `PlaylistServiceCachingTests.loadsCachedPlaylistOnInit` and `PlaylistServiceTests.observerReceivesCachedDataDuringCacheLoad` — have distinct names that reflect different observable behaviours under test (initial cache load vs. observer notification during a cache load), so the structural similarity (Jaccard 0.7) is consistent with two legitimately separate test scenarios that happen to share setup scaffolding rather than true redundancy. Collapsing them would obscure test intent and violate the principle that each test should document one behaviour.
